choices.label: Message Jordan: 'DEREK HAS A SPINE??'
choices.result: Jordan: 'WHAT.' Kai: 'screenshot or it didn't happen.' Derek has a spine. It just takes five printouts to activate.

speaker: veronica
text: Veronica is obeying Derek's rule. Technically. She doesn't sit near Marcus. She just discusses his work in the leadership chat, cc's his stakeholders, and asks you, loudly, whether 'some people' have submitted their stats yet.

choices.label: 'I don't know, I'm not near him either'
choices.result: Kai turns a laugh into a cough so violent that Jordan offers him water. Veronica narrows her eyes at all three of you.

choices.label: Screenshot the leadership chat messages
choices.result: Rule set by Derek. Rule bent in writing, timestamped, in a group chat with the CFO. Saved.

addEvidence.label: Chat: discussing Marcus after Derek's no-contact rule

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.result: She asks again, louder. Marcus, two rows away, heard it the first time.

speaker: veronica
text: Monday, 11am. Veronica walks out of a meeting with Derek, Gordon and HR. Garden leave, effective immediately. By 11:20 she's going desk to desk: 'Marcus did this to me. Be careful of him.' Marcus, who never filed a single complaint. Marcus, who kept quiet for months.

choices.label: 'Marcus never complained once. You did.'
choices.result: Said quietly, to the person she was just whispering to. They blink. Then nod. The whisper campaign dies at that desk.

choices.label: Message Marcus: 'Ignore whatever you hear today'
choices.result: 'Already heard. It's ok.' Then, a minute later: 'Thanks for being on my side.'

choices.label: Keep your head down until she's gone
choices.result: You count the minutes until her access card stops working. 4 hours, 12 minutes.

speaker: veronica
text: Her last hour. She books Nebula with you, of course. 'I'm leaving today. I wanted you to hear it from me. Don't trust Marcus. And honestly? This company cannot survive without me.' She's looking at you the way she did on your first day.

choices.label: 'Thank you for onboarding me.'
choices.result: True, and kind, and nothing more. She nods, satisfied, and doesn't notice what you didn't say. You'll think about this conversation for a long time.

choices.label: 'I think the team will be okay.'
choices.result: She studies your face for a long second. 'We'll see.' The team, it turns out, will be more than okay.

choices.label: Nod. Say nothing.
choices.result: She hugs you. You let her. Then she walks out with a box and a plant, and that's the last time you see her in the office.

text: 11:40pm. A LinkedIn message: 'Hi! Exciting opportunity, Senior Analyst, great culture, no micromanagement 🙂'. You've been staring at Veronica's 10:30pm Slack for twenty minutes.

choices.label: Reply: 'Happy to chat'
choices.result: A call is booked for Thursday lunch. You'll take it from the car park, like a spy.

choices.label: Leave it on read
choices.result: Not now. The team needs you. Probably. You'll check again in a month.

text: The email arrives during the 2pm stats update: an offer. 18% more, a manager whose reviews say 'reasonable', and nobody who will ever say 'come, toilet'. Signing deadline: Friday.

choices.label: Sign it. Resign today.
choices.result: You hand Derek your letter. Then you go home and sleep for eleven hours.

choices.label: Decline. You're not leaving them with her.
choices.result: You write 'thank you, but not right now' and close the laptop. Kai, Jordan, Marcus. Not yet.

choices.label: Ask for a later start date
choices.result: They give you until the end of the quarter. A safety net. You'll decide later. Probably at 2am.

speaker: kai
text: Kai shows you his phone, unimpressed. A recruiter finally came through with an offer. It's... fine. 4% more, an office 20 minutes further from home, and a 'flexible' WFH policy that is one day a month. 'Is this worth leaving for?' he asks. Neither of you is sure what 'this' refers to.

choices.label: 'Negotiate. Ask for what you're worth.'
choices.result: He asks for 15%. They come back with 5% and a free gym membership. Kai declines. 'Even Veronica is better than a gym membership.' He pauses. 'Almost.'

choices.label: 'Not good enough. Stay, we need you.'
choices.result: He declines it the same afternoon. 'Ok. But you're buying kopi until she's gone.' Deal.

choices.label: 'Take it anyway. Get out while you can.'
choices.result: He takes it, half-hearted. Two weeks later his desk is empty except for a sticky note: 'Nebula Survivors forever. Don't let her win.'

speaker: veronica
text: Friday. Something's off. Veronica is being... nice. She buys the whole team kaya toast. She compliments Marcus's deck, from a distance of exactly four desks. Derek's calendar for Monday 9am just says 'Meeting (private)'.

choices.label: Eat the kaya toast. Say nothing.
choices.result: It's very good kaya toast. It tastes like the last day of something.

choices.label: Message the group chat: 'why is she being nice'
choices.result: Kai: 'she knows.' Jordan: 'she doesn't know.' Marcus: 'eat the toast.' Wise words.

choices.label: Ask her if everything's ok
choices.result: 'Of course! Why wouldn't it be?' She smiles too long. You eat your toast very quickly.

speaker: veronica
text: A calendar invite: 'Quick chat', with HR copied. Veronica slides a document across the table. Performance Improvement Plan. Section 1, 'Areas of concern': visibility, ownership, and 'attitude when asked to come to the toilet'.

choices.label: Sign it. You're too tired to fight.
choices.result: Six weeks of daily check-ins with the person who wrote the PIP. You don't make it to week four.

choices.label: Refuse to sign. Ask HR for the evidence.
choices.result: HR asks Veronica for the evidence. Veronica produces a spreadsheet with one row: 'vibes'. The PIP is 'paused for review'.

addEvidence.label: HR paused a PIP that had no evidence behind it

choices.label: Bring your delivery log to the meeting
choices.result: Twelve weeks of shipped work, dated and linked. The HR partner reads it, looks at Veronica, and says 'let's take this offline'. For once, you love that phrase.
